title: Welcome to the Ledger Exam
tagline: Only a single digit number pass each year. Sometimes only one.

intro.text: The road runs long and open. Duke and Lyra walk it together, mid-conversation — loose, unhurried, nothing like the two people who met at arrow-point a day ago. Whatever they're saying, it's theirs. The camera pulls back until they're two small figures against a very long road.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: 2 Hours Later
They crest a hill and the venue opens up below — a large compound, banners, Bureau signage, staff moving with purpose. And outside it, candidates. A hundred of them. Maybe two.

intro.speaker: Lyra
intro.text: So this is the exam site? Wasn't expecting so many people.

intro.speaker: Duke
intro.text: Yeah. First time for me too. I hear only a single digit number pass each year. Sometimes only one.
Lyra looks at the crowd again with fresh eyes.

intro.speaker: Lyra
intro.text: Only one!? That's harsh.

outro.text: Duke doesn't answer. He's already doing the math. They keep walking.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A long desk. Forms. Pens. Number tags pinned to their outfits by an admin who has done this a thousand times and will do it a thousand more. Around them, candidates compare numbers, or sit alone, or move like people who have been here before.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: A large sign on the wall: "Phase 1 — Head This Way →"

An admin leads them into a large room. Fifty candidates already inside — some clustered into groups talking strategy, others deliberately alone, backs to the walls, watching. Duke and Lyra both read the same thing in it at the same time.

intro.speaker: Duke
intro.text: Hey. I know we just met — but interested in a team up? Looks like there are other teams here already. Could have its pros and cons either way.
Lyra scans the room. Groups. Loners. The numbers.

intro.speaker: Lyra
intro.text: Two heads are better than one. Sure.

intro.speaker: Duke
intro.text: Yeah.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: No handshake. No ceremony. Just a quiet agreement between two people who already know they can handle themselves.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The room settles. A large screen on the wall flickers on.
A face appears. Older man. White ponytail, white beard, deeply lined face. Red eyes. The room goes quiet immediately — not because anyone told it to.

intro.speaker: Master Tao
intro.text: Good morning. You may address me as Master Tao. I am your examiner for Phase 1.

intro.speaker: Master Tao
intro.text: Your objective is simple. Traverse this forest and find me. I will be waiting at a location within it. To qualify for Phase 2, you must face me in combat and earn my approval.

intro.speaker: Master Tao
intro.text: I will do my best to hold back. But I am not permitted to go easy on you — so I expect everything you have. The first 20 candidates I approve will advance. The rest will not.

intro.speaker: Master Tao
intro.text: Good luck.

intro.speaker: Narrator
intro.text: The screen turns off. Nobody says anything for a while.

outro.text: Outside, the venue is all noise — candidates comparing notes, sizing each other up. Duke and Lyra stand slightly apart from it.

outro.speaker: Lyra
outro.text: The old man looks strong. Think we can beat him?

outro.speaker: Duke
outro.text: I don't know. But it's not like we can just proceed without fighting him.

outro.speaker: Lyra
outro.text: Oh? Not confident? How's your Toll then?
Duke glances at his hand and raises it. Toll answers — water energy coiling slowly around his hand and up his forearm. Not a display. More like checking in with it.

outro.speaker: Duke
outro.text: Still figuring it out. Right now I'm just integrating it with my martial arts. Nothing like what you can do with your ice.

outro.speaker: Lyra
outro.text: My ice? That reminds me — you avoided any real damage during our little encounter.

outro.speaker: Narrator
outro.text: They look at each other. A beat. Then both of them smile — small, quiet, almost reluctant.
